subject: Post-call: SOC2 + retention evidence compendium & action plan
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Audrey Chen <audrey@pivotalpay.com>, Tom Baxter <tbaxter@pivotalpay.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: SOC2 + retention evidence compendium & action plan

Hi Audrey / Tom — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on what PivotalPay needs and what Redwood can deliver to clear security gating quickly.

Call summary (high level)
- Pain: SOC 2 acceptance + audit-log retention and export for regulators; legal needs DPA + assurance on pen test coverage.
- Current blocker: internal Audit wants direct artifact access (sample exports) and clarity on how long logs live in each tier.
- Goal: complete a security evidence package and path to formal acceptance within 3 weeks so procurement can finalize terms.

Priority asks / what we will deliver from Redwood
1) Evidence compendium: SOC 2 mapping + links to artifacts (control owner, evidence path). Target delivery: 2026-09-09.
2) Audit-log sample: 7-day anonymized CSV export showing retention headers and rotation metadata. Target: 2026-09-08.
3) Pen test summary: high-level scope & remediation status (we will redact sensitive items). Target: 2026-09-09.
4) DPA draft and DocuSign path for your legal review. Target: 2026-09-10.

Immediate asks from PivotalPay
- Please confirm primary legal reviewer and whether you prefer a redlined DPA or our standard template.
- Can you share any minimum retention windows your regulator requires (e.g., 90 / 180 days)?

Next steps / checkpoints
- Redwood to send the evidence compendium and two artifacts (audit-log sample + pen test summary) by next week.
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up on 2026-09-10 to walk through artifacts with your auditors. Suggested window: 09:00–11:00 PT.
- Aditya to own the technical walkthrough; Marissa to coordinate legal and procurement items.

If that matches your expectations I’ll ship the compendium and upload artifacts to the shared drive and HubSpot deal.

Thanks — Sofia

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform

---

From: Audrey Chen <audrey@pivotalpay.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Tom Baxter <tbaxter@pivotalpay.com>
Cc: legal@pivotalpay.com
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2026 18:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC2 + retention evidence compendium & action plan

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear summary. That timeline looks workable for us. Quick answers below and attached the first set of documents.

Who’s reviewing DPA: Legal (legal@pivotalpay.com) will lead; they prefer a redline if possible.
Retention minimums: Regulator requires 180 days for audit logs; we prefer to see 1 year as a stretch goal.
Audit scope notes: The auditors will want a time-series export and evidence of rotation/archival policies.

I attached: PivotalPay_SOC2_Questions.pdf (list of specific controls they will probe), pen-test-summary-2025.pdf (our internal pen-test 3rd-party report), and a small sample auditlog-sample-7days.csv (anonymized).

We’d like the compendium uploaded to your Drive link and a DocuSign stub for DPA redline. Can you also include a short section in the compendium describing how Redwood handles KV cache/auto-batching traces — audit wants to understand caching behavior and what is persisted vs ephemeral.

Tom and I are available for the 09/10 09:00–10:00 PT slot.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Audrey

Audrey Chen
Head of Compliance, PivotalPay
audrey@pivotalpay.com | +1 617-555-0210

Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC2 + retention evidence compendium & action plan

Thanks Audrey — got the attachments and the retention ask. Quick updates:

- We’ll include a dedicated section in the compendium on caching and KV persistence. It will explicitly call out what is ephemeral (per-request KV cache) vs persisted logs and where each is stored (hot tier vs cold tier).
- Target delivery stands: audit-log sample (9/8), compendium + pen test summary upload (9/9), DPA draft to legal for redline (9/10).
- Aditya: I’ve looped you in to own the technical walkthrough and to prepare a 10–15 minute demo of how export / masking works. Can you scope a short checklist (what auditors will see vs what’s redacted)?

Aditya, Marissa — please confirm you can:
- Prepare a 7-step checklist for the walkthrough (data model, retention policies, export steps, masking, rotation, audit logs retention TTLs, proof of deletion).
- Be available on 2026-09-10 at 09:00 PT for the call.

Audrey / Tom — I’ll upload the artifacts to the HubSpot deal and Drive link and drop a DocuSign stub for the DPA. Expect the Drive link in a follow-up within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Sofia

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
